analyst.summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies makes specialty enzymes used across nutraceuticals, pharma, food and industrial applications, with real technical know-how behind its products. The business has had an inconsistent profit record over the past five years, but the last few quarters show a genuine acceleration in both sales and profit. The valuation is undemanding, but the longer track record means this improvement needs another few quarters to prove it's durable rather than a good patch.
